lines.text: Five platforms. Five dashboards. Five tabs you never close.
Buddy Socials puts them all on one board. YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X and LinkedIn. Every account, side by side.
And the board is yours. Pick your widgets, resize them, and drag them into place on your phone. The desktop follows in real time.
Every post shows the numbers its own platform reports.
Write a post once. Add a picture or a video, crop it, choose your accounts, and publish to all of them at once.
Comments from every platform land in one inbox. And goals tell you if you're on pace.
It runs on macOS and Linux, and it updates itself. On Android, seven resizable widgets put your numbers right on the home screen.
Buddy Socials. All your socials, on a board you built.
